name: Life in Prison
desc:
Play Life in Prison!

# PC Keybinds
Shift - Run
Ctrl - Cam-lock
V - Cam-lock mode
C - Crawl
Backspace - Drop
R - Reload
E/Q - UFO Up-Down
Shift + Motorcycle - Wheelie
T + Police car - Siren/gate open
Right Mouse/Z - Scope
F - Punch/Detonate C4

# Mobile Keybinds
Drag items from inventory to drop
Customize touch layout in settings

# Controller Keybinds
L3 - run
Y - Crawl/UFO Up
B - Punch/UFO Down
X - Reload
D-Pad ⬆️ - Scope
D-Pad ➡️ - Cam-lock
D-Pad ⬅️ - Cam-lock mode

# Private Servers
As owner of a private server you unlock many commands to control the game.
/cmd - Terminal
/cmds - List commands
